mechanism: Cases were mostly run on plates 1-2 and controls on plates 3-4, and plates shift every protein, so a classifier learns the plate, not disease. A high CV AUROC does not show a cancer signature; the label is essentially readable from the processing batch.
quantify: plate or run date alone predicts case status with AUROC ~0.82
~85% of cases on plates 1-2 vs ~15% of controls
fix: Randomize cases and controls across plates; correct for plate inside CV folds; validate on an independently processed cohort before calling it a signature.
